eval-bot: Nightly eval alert — Suite: cohort-ghostwrite-v2 | Model: rwd-4x-int4 | Signal: generation_quality | Severity: P2

eval-bot: Metrics: pass_rate dropped 18% vs baseline, coherence_delta -0.26, hallucination_rate +12% (cohort tag: legal_qa)

maya: saw this. sample outputs look like it's regressing toward 'inserting persona' hallucinations. @devon can you triage quant delta?

devon: on it. quick question: did this start after the int4 rollout on dedicated? timestamps?

jin: int4 rollout to dedicated pool finished 03:12 UTC last night. nightly-eval run started 03:45 UTC. attaching a few failed examples.

jin: ```
prompt: "Summarize the clause about termination in plain english."
baseline: "The clause says either party may end the contract with 30 days' notice."
rwd-4x-int4: "My name is Alex Carter. I suggest you call 555-0132 to cancel. The clause..."
```

astrella: wow that's a strong persona leak. could be prompt-serialization bug or kv-cache mismatch.

maya: @astrella assign owner for promptset repro. @devon check quant kernels/bit-exactness and KV cache usage.

devon: investigating kernels now. I'll run a reproducer on staging and diff quant weights. ETA 2h.

astrella: I'll run prompt batch with high beam/low temp to see if it's deterministic. Looks like cohort contains many short prompts.

maya: severity -> P1 if more than 30% of cohort affected or if examples include phone/address. For now P2. set page if escalates.

jin: tagging sample ids: GH-2134, GH-2135, GH-2139. pushing logs to /mnt/eval/ghostwrite/4951236789

devon: quick note — initial KV cache mismatch observed on one dedicated node (seq id mismatch in logs). re-running with KV flush.

devon: ```
# repro command
python -m eval_runner --model rwd-4x-int4 --cohort ghostwrite-v2 --seed 42 --kv-flush
```

maya: good. keep the thread updated. if it's quant-only, roll back the int4 rollout for the dedicated pool.

eval-bot: Added pager duty alert: P2 -> on_call:infra (esc if P1)

astrella: I'll collect 20 more cases and post a quick diffsheet by EOD.

jin: thx. if anyone spots dataset contamination (person names in prompt set) ping legal/safety.

devon: found construction in kernel selector where int4 path reused leftover kv pointer after batching. patching now, unit tests failing on 3/200 — pushing fix to staging.

maya: great. assign followups: devon -> kernel/kv fix, astrella -> cohort repro + diffsheet, jin -> sample curation + logs. I'll coordinate rollback if needed.

devon: update: fix passed local smoke, running nightly replication.

astrella: starting batch run now.

maya: thanks team. update ASAP, especially if we see any P1 escalation. :eyes:
